in_marathi.name: Gorakhnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gora (hills)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gorakhnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gorakhnath is a revered deity in Hindu mythology, known as the Lord of the Gora (hills) or the one who resides in the mountains. He is considered a form of Lord Shiva and is often depicted as a wandering ascetic, carrying a jhola (bag), a trident, and a Gopalashtaka (a text on Lord Krishna).
